steps.content: Sweat drips from the hair matted to your brow, seeping into your eyes. The sting threatens to blind you, yet you force yourself to hold her gaze.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You already used me to get in here. You got what you wanted.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I told you, I'm done with you. And I meant it.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Yes. I've tasted the power of that <color=#fb9259>thing</color>. It's extraordinary, truly... The way it can draw the mind and spirit... That is exactly what I need.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: So why not lend that power to me once more?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "Lend"? Is that what you call it? The way you command those ghosts, the way you just controlled my body?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And what would you do with it? Drag your shifu back from the dead?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's no way you can bring the dead back. What you've been looking for doesn't even exist. Just look around. There's nothing but monsters in the Void of Yin! Your shifu is dead! She died a long time ago!
A smile tugs at the edges of her mouth. She pulls your hands closer against herself. The two of you are nearly touching now, but her body offers no heat, only an unsettling cold.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Of course I know she has long since passed. What I saw was nothing more than a phantom, shaped by my own obsession.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Looking at it another way, that's a puzzle solved for me.

options: If you knew it was just your obsession...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your shifu's death... is that all it ever was to you? Just some puzzle to solve...? I thought...
Your voice dwindles to a whisper, and yet the smile on her face only grows deeper.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Shifu drove herself to madness and death trying to prove there is a way to cross the boundary between life and death, to stand against the calamity. And she never once regretted it.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: So if someone can finally find an answer, I think that would give her peace.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And such a way... it may not be out of reach after all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you already knew what you saw was just born out of your delusion, then stop. Let it go.
Your voice swells with rage, but the smile on her face only deepens in return.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: "Delusion"... Heh. Yes, you're right. To be honest, after all these years, I can barely remember her face anymore.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: But one thing I do remember. Even as she lost her mind, even at the end, she never stopped searching for a way to transcend life and death, to stand against the calamity.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And that way... it may be more than just my delusion after all.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>"Believe, and it shall be."</color>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Believe, and it shall be... Those specters that blocked our path, they showed up because you led people to "believe," didn't they?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But whatever they are now, you can't exactly call them alive. This whole transcendence of life and death is just nonsense.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: If they can be put to use, does it really matter whether they're truly "alive" or not?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Speaking of which, what does that make you, I wonder? Hiding inside a child's body the way you are?
You press your mouth into a hard line, giving no reply. The grip at your collar seems to cinch ever tighter.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: It's alright. Whatever you are, I don't mind. As long as you're willing to help.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: After everything we've been through together, do you still not trust me?
You meet her gaze at last, and it dawns on you. You recognize that look in those eyes. You saw it long ago, before you ever entered the Void of Yin.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>If I learn the truth at dawn, I can die content by dusk.</color><i>
Her grey, bloodless lips stir again.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content:
Fear not.
<i><color=#7683a2>Fear not.</color><i>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I... don't trust you...!
